account-locked: Achka pantasqa yaykuy munasqakunarayku yupayqa kunanpaq wichqasqam. Ama hina kaspa qhipata wakmanta munay.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panelqa SuperAdminpaqlla, Cloud Panel dominiopi.
cloud-settings-desc: WeKan Weddy ukhupi kaqwan, Cloud Panel huk servidormanta achka WeKan dominiokunata serviyun, sapankaqa kikin willakuyninkunawan. Cloud Panel dominiopi, SuperAdmin dominiokunata CloudFlaretawan kamachin.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: CloudFlare API llavewan, huk dominio, zonan qampa CloudFlare cuentaykipi kaqqa, proxy DNS qillqata CloudFlare Origin certificadotawan chaskin. Huk dominiokunaqa Let's Encrypt certificadota chaskinku. Llaveqa servidorpi waqaychasqa, manañataq hayk'appas rikuchikunqachu.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Mana CloudFlare API llave waqaychasqachu: sapa dominio Let's Encrypt certificadota chaskin.
error-notAuthorized: Kay p'anqata qhawanaykipaq manam saqillasqachu kanki.
